craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Cross-verse sentence opened (completes v38 per UNC); rings-hollow close. Rejected: (a) closing here → killed: sentence runs on. Read aloud: IF-mind's a-RIS-ing STANDS un-MARKED … NO-pur-POSE-holds.

lines: If mind's arising stands unmarked by any spirit's eye,
then 'for the spirit's sake' rings hollow — no purpose holds.

reads_against.argmap: Unperceived arising — whose purpose? → No puruṣārthatā where no spirit perceives (sentence completes in v38).
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
